tests.procedure: Run the retained real M1.3 host without a relay.
tests.expected: Legacy startup remains valid; only shared bridge same-frame protection applies, not relay held/focus guarantees.

tests.procedure: Add one registered uninitialized relay with a real ready provider and use the existing bootstrap.
tests.expected: Relay initializes between bridge and UI; no automatic new/load/save.

tests.procedure: Add two relays, an initialized relay, or an invalid InputOwner in a disposable host.
tests.expected: Read-only preflight blocks before permanent binding.

tests.procedure: Repeat the exact successful startup and then repeat after destroying the bound relay.
tests.expected: First repeat is AlreadyStarted without extra contexts; lost required binding requires relaunch.

tests.procedure: Select NativeEnhancedInput, remove competing Interact handlers, forward actual Hyper focus, press/release E.
tests.expected: Exactly one appropriate bridge action per fresh press.

tests.procedure: Repeat the complete world loop with face-left and controller-only menus.
tests.expected: One action per fresh press and no world action while UI owns focus.

tests.procedure: Select VendorEvents and forward actual aggregate input-down and released states.
tests.expected: No native context is created; held true does not repeat; false and a later press permits another action.

tests.procedure: Submit external state to a native-mode relay and attempt to hot-change its property.
tests.expected: External input rejected; initialized ownership does not silently switch.

tests.procedure: In native mode hold E and face-left together, then release only one.
tests.expected: No second action until the aggregate input is released and pressed again.

tests.procedure: Deliver two direct bridge TryInteract calls for the same door in one engine frame.
tests.expected: Only one door toggle; second call is SuppressedInput and broadcasts no recursive notice.

tests.procedure: With both parts carried, issue two same-frame radio interactions before inspection.
tests.expected: Inspection happens once; repair does not execute in the same frame. A later explicit press is required.

tests.procedure: Temporarily wire an action-notice listener to call another bridge interaction/transfer/acknowledgement synchronously.
tests.expected: Nested call is SuppressedInput; no second mutation or recursive notice loop.

tests.procedure: Hold Interact for several seconds through each world-object type.
tests.expected: Relay does not repeat door toggles, repair attempts, transcript opens or pickups.

tests.procedure: Hold Interact through opening and closing inventory/pause/storage/transcript.
tests.expected: No world action leaks; fresh focus and release then later press are required.

tests.procedure: Acquire and release a legitimate unique bridge UI blocker between relay ticks.
tests.expected: Permission revision invalidates the previous focus even though final blocked state is unchanged.

tests.procedure: Pause the real game through the host while no Coastal menu is open.
tests.expected: Direct world interactions and relay offers are blocked; UI-owned storage operations remain separately allowed.

tests.procedure: Save/load or replace a campaign while focus is on a valid actor and input remains held.
tests.expected: Old epoch focus/input is rejected; no automatic follow-on action.

tests.procedure: Stop forwarding selected-target updates while leaving a previously focused actor alive.
tests.expected: Offer hides and input rejects once sample age exceeds two frames; no target scanning or reacquisition.

tests.procedure: Forward A then B, followed by a delayed ClearFocusedTarget(A).
tests.expected: B remains the current focus; clearing B or forwarding null removes it.

tests.procedure: After valid focus, submit an unregistered or wrong-world Coastal actor.
tests.expected: Old valid focus is cleared and the invalid actor cannot be acted on.

tests.procedure: Destroy the focused actor in a disposable test; also test collected/hidden pickups.
tests.expected: Weak stale target cannot act; collected pickup offer is hidden; no repeated grant.

tests.procedure: Press when focus is absent/expired, then provide a fresh target while the key stays held.
tests.expected: No queued retry occurs; release and explicit new press is required.

tests.procedure: Use actual Hyper focus on a distant actor and an actor behind the test obstruction.
tests.expected: Disabled offer/reason when applicable and commit-time TooFar/Occluded; no remote pickup/repair.

tests.procedure: Poll offers repeatedly for every kind before/after reading and repairing; inspect provider/world/mission/ledger.
tests.expected: No state mutations, receipts, transcript acknowledgement or saves from reads alone.

tests.procedure: Move one required part into actual storage, inspect the radio offer, return it to backpack.
tests.expected: Readiness follows carried requirements; no availability inferred from remote storage or cached count.

tests.procedure: Fill the actual AGIS backpack and press Take on a required item with an enabled offer.
tests.expected: Real NoSpace leaves the pickup retrievable; an enabled offer never grants or guarantees capacity.

tests.procedure: Open native storage and transfer while its UI pauses gameplay; then open transcript and acknowledge after presentation.
tests.expected: UI-specific transfer/ack paths still work with the shared dispatch guard; world Interact remains blocked.

tests.procedure: Make the real provider unavailable or put the coordinator in terminal recovery in a disposable run.
tests.expected: Offers hide and input fails closed; no fake inventory, mutation or automatic save/new campaign.

tests.procedure: Change/destroy the possessed character and then exit/reenter the map.
tests.expected: No silent rebinding; old input/prompt cannot act, and relay-owned resources are removed without clearing unrelated mappings.

tests.procedure: Exercise both input routes and vendor updates at low/variable frame rates with actual rendering.
tests.expected: Lease ordering is acceptable, presses do not target indefinitely stale selections, and no hidden repeat/queued action occurs.

tests.procedure: Build/cook/package the actual systems map for Windows, launch outside editor, finish the whole campaign, exit and Continue.
tests.expected: Coherent pickup/storage/repair/transcript/save/relaunch loop without loss or duplication; record actual evidence.
